scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @flight/shared" "npm run dev -w @flight/api" "npm run dev -w @flight/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @flight/api && npm run build -w @flight/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @flight/api && npm run typecheck -w @flight/web && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:load: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx tests/load/run.ts
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @flight/api
